+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+def split_repl_line(string: str) -> list[str]:
+    """Split a line entered in an interactive command editor into
+    tokens. Behaves like :func:`~click.shell_completion.split_arg_string`,
+    but also treats commas outside of quotes as token separators, the
+    same as whitespace. Commas inside quoted values are kept literally.
+    A missing closing quote or incomplete escape sequence is ignored and
+    the partial token is used as-is.
+
+    .. code-block:: python
+
+        split_repl_line("add a,b 'c,d'")
+        ["add", "a", "b", "c,d"]
+
+        split_repl_line("add a, 'my file")
+        ["add", "a", "my file"]
+
+    :param string: String to split.
+    """
+    import shlex
+
+    lex = shlex.shlex(string, posix=True)
+    lex.whitespace_split = True
+    lex.whitespace += ","
+    lex.commenters = ""
+    out = []
+
+    try:
+        for token in lex:
+            out.append(token)
+    except ValueError:
+        # Raised when end-of-string is reached in an invalid state. Use
+        # the partial token as-is. The quote or escape character is in
+        # lex.state, not lex.token.
+        out.append(lex.token)
+
+    return out

@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import pytest
+
+from click.repl_parser import split_repl_line
+from click.shell_completion import split_arg_string
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("value", "expect"),
+    [
+        ("cli a b c", ["cli", "a", "b", "c"]),
+        ("cli a,b,c", ["cli", "a", "b", "c"]),
+        ("cli a, b ,c", ["cli", "a", "b", "c"]),
+        ("cli a,,b", ["cli", "a", "b"]),
+        (",cli,", ["cli"]),
+        ("cli 'a,b' \"c,d\"", ["cli", "a,b", "c,d"]),
+        ("cli a\\,b", ["cli", "a,b"]),
+        ("cli 'my file", ["cli", "my file"]),
+        ("cli a,'my,file", ["cli", "a", "my,file"]),
+        ("cli my\\", ["cli", "my"]),
+        ("cli a,my\\", ["cli", "a", "my"]),
+        ("cli a#b", ["cli", "a#b"]),
+        ("", []),
+        (" , ", []),
+    ],
+)
+def test_split_repl_line(value, expect):
+    assert split_repl_line(value) == expect
+
+
+def test_split_arg_string_keeps_commas():
+    assert split_arg_string("cli a,b") == ["cli", "a,b"]
